checks: saved declaration reported separately from actual DSH metadata without a probe
actual HTTP reasoning value mapped and output bounded
off can omit the parameter or send the explicitly declared API value
declared image capability reaches a real multimodal HTTP request
text-only declaration rejects image tool locally and sends only its text error
model switch does not inherit declarations; switching back restores its saved declaration
runtime default off mapping is stated in UI and verified on the wire
restart persistence, zero replay and credential-safe projection
reset removes manual request behavior even when the unsaved draft is invalid

limitations: Synthetic loopback services only; no real-model acceptance for this package.
Preview is source evidence; packaged collaboration is separate.
Existing corrupt DSH histories are preserved, not automatically repaired.
First failed installer retained separately; same app.asar does not mean same bridge or installer.
No second Windows or long-term real-time acceptance; no public publication.
